purpose_context: Users on different display resolutions and screen sizes may find the fixed 250x250 pt Bitz overlay too large or too small. Provide manual size controls in BitzMenuBarContentView (presets and +/- 10% step buttons) that proportionally resize MascotOverlayPanel and MascotOverlayView while keeping bottom-right anchoring, 100% click-through windowing, and UserDefaults persistence across launches.
purpose_tldr: Allow users to manually resize Bitz via Menu Bar presets and step controls (50%–175% scale) with proportional panel/canvas scaling and UserDefaults persistence.
